body:
Adds `research/blur-twin`: a moving bar is an exact trapezoid under finite exposure; a twin-tuned peak detector has speed limit `wC/(σz)`; a blur-matched box filter raises it quadratically (5–55× over 12 settings). Pure Python, 9 tests, results from `experiments/results.txt`. README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok (182 projects).

Stylised: 1-D, known location, constant velocity, white Gaussian noise, no real footage. Builds on the ARPG / RECUV sensor-simulation direction; no affiliation implied.
